events.title: PyTorch public beta released
events.summary: Facebook AI Research released PyTorch public beta (v0.1.6) on January 21, 2017 — a Python-first [deep learning] framework with dynamic computation graphs.
events.about: PyTorch's eager execution (`tensor.backward()`) felt like NumPy with [GPU] acceleration — researchers debugged models interactively instead of rebuilding static graphs. It overtook TensorFlow in academic papers and powered transformers, diffusion models, and Meta's Llama training stack.

narrative.whyChosen: PyTorch made dynamic [neural network]s the default for AI research.
narrative.whyImportant: Pythonic APIs and autograd lowered the barrier for [deep learning] experimentation.
narrative.problemSolved: TensorFlow 1.x's static graphs were hard to debug and iterate on for research code.

sources.title: PyTorch Blog — Accelerating research with PyTorch beta (January 18, 2017)
